calendar_coverage.derivation: weekday AND not in transcribed official SSE closure list; single-source transcription

context_only_scope.note: context rows are clearly marked and are NOT part of the requested scope

historical_availability_coverage.note: historical_availability coverage is 0. No delivered row is proven to have been public at any historical cutoff.

delivery_reported_coverage.longest_consecutive_exchange_session_run: Computed over delivered bars (context + requested scope) using the derived calendar. The value is large because the unexplained gaps are CLUSTERED (Feb 2016, Dec 2018-Jan 2019, Jun-Jul 2019); after the last gap the series runs uninterrupted to 2023-12-29. The prior collection's 43 sparse Sina captures had longest run 1, so the Sohu series is materially denser. A long run here is NOT a claim of point-in-time usability.
delivery_reported_coverage.metadata_candidate_21_row_windows_note: Count of 21-BAR, calendar-consecutive raw candidates inside the requested scope. This is a RAW-SERIES denseness count only. It is NOT a maturity/label count, NOT a support-condition check, and does NOT assert any window is usable, because point-in-time availability is unresolved for all rows.

status_coverage.note: Coverage is effectively zero for the window. Absence of a status row is NOT NORMAL trading.

source_gaps.description: Every daily bar delivered is evidence_class=CURRENT_QUERY_ONLY. The single Sohu hisHq request returns 2160 continuous rows, but it is a CURRENT query: it proves the values exist NOW, not that any specific version was public before a given prediction cutoff. No point-in-time (as-of) reconstruction is possible from this package.
methods_attempted: Sohu hisHq current query (success, current only)
Internet Archive CDX + id_ replay (unreachable: CONNECT tunnel 502 through local egress proxy)
prior collections: 43 unique Sina quote captures (longest consecutive run = 1)
source_gaps.next_step: Obtain an authorised PIT data product (e.g. a licensed historical database with as-of semantics), or restore network access to web.archive.org / a WARC corpus and crawl dense captures.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: No reachable source exposes an as-of/revision view of the daily-bar series, and the web archive became unreachable mid-collection so captured historical versions could not be retrieved.

source_gaps.description: No source documented a revision policy for its daily-bar series. revision_chain_completeness = 0.

evidence_refs.locator: response header/body - no as-of or revision metadata

methods_attempted: inspected response bodies for revision/as-of fields
source_gaps.next_step: Request the provider's data-change log, or reconstruct versions from dense third-party archives.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: Providers publish a single current state; no documented version chain is exposed.

source_gaps.description: Per-trading-day trading status, ST/special-treatment flag and applicable daily price limit were NOT delivered. Only one date (2016-02-16) has an explicit suspension row. Absence of a status row must NOT be read as NORMAL; ST status must NOT be inferred from a missing ST field.
methods_attempted: SSE per-date suspension list (works per date, not as a full history)
source_gaps.next_step: Pull the exchange's full suspension/ST history (authorised data product) or parse every daily bulletin.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: No reachable source served a complete per-day status history for the window without bulk authorised access.

source_gaps.description: 30 exchange-session dates derived from the official SSE calendar have NO Sohu bar. 2016-02 dates are explained by an official suspension (2016-02-16..2016-02-26). The 2018-12/2019-01 and 2019-06/07 gaps have NO located suspension notice and are recorded as UNEXPLAINED - a missing bar is NOT inferred to be a suspension.
methods_attempted: searched SSE suspension list for the gap dates
tried longer Tencent ranges (0 rows) and Sina (1023 recent rows only)
source_gaps.next_step: Query the exchange's official daily quotation bulletins for the gap dates, or an authorised bar history.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: No explanation found for the non-February gaps from any reachable source.

source_gaps.affected_dates_or_scope: volume_shares / amount_yuan on every delivered bar
source_gaps.description: The x100 (手->shares) and x10000 (万元->yuan) conversions are validated on ONE overlapping day against SSE official statistics (2023-12-29: OHLC identical, 1249.13万股 vs 124913手, amount 22208.65万元 identical). The same conversions are assumed constant across 2016-2023 and are NOT independently verified per year. A prior collection found a 500-CNY-scale discrepancy on 2025-12-31 (outside this window).

evidence_refs.locator: column labels 成交量(手)/成交金额(万)

methods_attempted: attempted the same for 2016/2019 (SSE query returns empty)
source_gaps.next_step: Cross-validate a sample of 2016-2022 dates against an authorised second source.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: SSE daily statistics only serve ~2023 onward, so most years have no independent unit check.

source_gaps.affected_dates_or_scope: 2013-2023 cash distributions; all non-cash action types
source_gaps.description: 11 cash-dividend implementation PDFs were retrieved individually. This is NOT a complete-scope catalogue: no source with a complete action-scope register was located, so any year absent from the list is SEARCHED_NO_HIT, not EXPLICIT_NO_EVENT. Bonus shares, capitalization, rights issues, splits and reverse splits have no delivered complete row.
methods_attempted: cninfo announcement index (700 rows) keyword search
source_gaps.next_step: Use an authorised corporate-action data product, or hand-verify the full filing list year by year.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: cninfo serves filings, not a machine-readable complete corporate-action register.

source_gaps.description: web.archive.org became unreachable through the local egress MITM proxy (CONNECT tunnel 502 / HTTP 000) after an initial partial success. The CDX index had confirmed captures exist for the target URLs, but the capture bodies could not be retrieved. NO archive payload was fabricated.
source_gaps.next_step: Restore direct or alternate egress to web.archive.org and re-run the capture retrieval.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: Network-layer proxy failure to archive.org, not a provider restriction.

source_gaps.description: The user's real broker commission is UNKNOWN and is deliberately NOT set to 0. A research scenario rate is an assumption and is not evidence of the rate actually paid.
methods_attempted: checked official fee/tax originals (these do NOT include broker commission)
source_gaps.next_step: User supplies their own broker fee schedule / trade confirmations.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: Broker commission is a per-account private commercial term; it cannot be collected from public sources.

source_gaps.description: Sohu redistributes SSE market data. Source independence from the exchange feed is NOT proven, and no second independent continuous bar series was reachable to cross-validate 2016-2022. The 2023-12-29 check shows AGREEMENT with SSE official statistics, which supports (but does not prove) the conversion and values.
source_gaps.next_step: Add an authorised second bar source for cross-validation of 2016-2022.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: No independent continuous source was reachable for the early window.

source_gaps.description: Sohu's history endpoint returns no separate preclose field in the delivered payload; the 'close' column is the day's close and the 'change' column is the day's change. A provider preclose, where it exists, may be an EX-RIGHTS REFERENCE PRICE rather than the prior RAW close. This package therefore sets reported_preclose=null with preclose_basis=null and does NOT compute a preclose from adjacent rows.
methods_attempted: inspected Sohu column labels and payload
source_gaps.next_step: Use a source that documents whether preclose is RAW or ex-rights-adjusted.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: Sohu does not expose a preclose field; SSE's PRE_CLOSE is available only for ~2023+ and its ex-rights semantics are not documented in the response.

source_gaps.description: The x100 / x10000 conversions are validated on one day (2023-12-29). Prior project work found a 500-CNY-scale amount discrepancy on 2025-12-31 against a different source. Both are recorded; neither is suppressed. The discrepancy is OUTSIDE the requested window and is not extrapolated.
source_gaps.next_step: Sample-check additional dates via an authorised source.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: Only one overlapping day is checkable with the reachable official source.

source_gaps.description: The trading calendar is DERIVED (weekday AND not in the transcribed official closure list), not a direct official per-day table. It agrees with the Sohu observed dates with ZERO conflicts, which is corroboration, but the derivation rule and the closure transcription are both single-source. Where the calendar says trading and no bar exists, the row is reported as a missing bar, NOT as a closure.
methods_attempted: compared derived calendar to observed bars (0 dates outside calendar)
source_gaps.next_step: Obtain the exchange's official per-day trading-calendar dataset.
source_gaps.why_unresolved: The official page is a notice list, not a machine-readable per-day table.

source_gaps.description: For the single date where two sources could be compared, Sohu and SSE official statistics AGREE exactly (OHLC identical; 124913手 x100 = 1249.13万股; 22208.65万元 identical). This is recorded as an explicit NO-CONFLICT result so the conflict count is not misread as 'nothing was compared'.

training_readiness.basis: Host verifies immutable acquisition bytes, not historical observation-time availability. Reported status/calendar/dividend dates are not complete execution or as-of proof.
